paragraphs: Pacira BioSciences, Inc., a Delaware corporation, is the holding company for our California operating subsidiary named Pacira Pharmaceuticals, Inc. In March 2007, we acquired Pacira Pharmaceuticals, Inc. from SkyePharma Holdings, Inc. (now Vectura Group Limited, a subsidiary of Molex Asia Holdings, Ltd.), or Skyepharma (the "Skyepharma Acquisition"). In April 2019, we acquired MyoScience, Inc., a privately held medical technology company (the "MyoScience Acquisition"), in November 2021, we acquired Flexion Therapeutics, Inc., or Flexion, a publicly traded biopharmaceutical company (the "Flexion Acquisition") and in February 2025, we acquired GQ Bio Therapeutics GmbH, or GQ Bio, a privately-held biopharmaceutical company (the "GQ Bio Acquisition"). Unless the context requires otherwise, references to "Pacira," "we," the "Company," the "Registrant," "us" and "our" in this Annual Report refers to Pacira BioSciences, Inc., a Delaware corporation, and its subsidiaries.

We were incorporated in Delaware under the name Blue Acquisition Corp. in December 2006 and changed our name to Pacira, Inc. in June 2007. In October 2010, we changed our name to Pacira Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and in April 2019, we changed our name to Pacira BioSciences, Inc. Our principal executive offices and corporate headquarters are located in Brisbane, California.

Pacira®, EXPAREL®, ZILRETTA®, iovera®°, the Pacira logo and other trademarks or service marks of Pacira appearing in this Annual Report are the property of Pacira, and when first used in each part of this Annual Report, include the ® symbol.

This Annual Report contains additional trade names, trademarks and service marks of other companies, which may or may not appear with the ® or ™ symbol. The absence of these symbols does not in any way imply that the respective owner(s) will not assert their rights to such marks to the fullest extent under applicable law. Our use of trademarks or trade names of other companies should not suggest any endorsement, sponsorship or other relationship with or by such companies.

Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients. We have three commercialized non-opioid treatments: EXPAREL® (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension), ZILRETTA® (triamcinolone acetonide extended-release injectable suspension) and iovera®°. EXPAREL—our flagship product—is a long-acting, local analgesic currently approved for postsurgical pain management. ZILRETTA is an extended-release, intra-articular, or IA (meaning in the joint), corticosteroid injection indicated for the management of osteoarthritis, or OA, knee pain. iovera° is our novel, handheld device for delivering immediate, long-acting, drug-free pain control using precise, controlled doses of cold temperature to a targeted nerve. We are also advancing an innovative pipeline that includes PCRX-201 (enekinragene inzadenovec), a novel, locally administered gene therapy that is in Phase 2 clinical development for the treatment of OA of the knee. PCRX-201 is the lead program from our proprietary high-capacity adenovirus, or HCAd, vector platform, which enables local administration of genetic medicines and has the potential to unlock gene therapy for large prevalent diseases affecting millions of people.

In January 2025, we launched our new 5x30 strategic growth plan ("5x30") to accelerate our transition into an innovative biopharmaceutical and therapeutic area leader in musculoskeletal pain and adjacencies. The 5x30 plan focuses on five key objectives that we intend to achieve by 2030: (i) deliver our products to more than three million patients annually; (ii) grow product revenues by a double-digit compounded annual growth rate; (iii) achieve a five percentage-point improvement in gross margins over 2024; (iv) advance an innovative pipeline with at least five programs in clinical development and (v) establish five partnerships—including pipeline and commercial agreements.

Since 5x30 was introduced, we have already made significant progress towards our long-term objectives. In 2025, we reached 2.5 million patients; volume trends show we are moving towards our goal of double-digit topline growth; we are on track for a five-percentage point improvement in gross margins through enhanced manufacturing efficiencies; progress has been made in the pipeline with new preclinical programs; and we have added two strategic partnerships, one for each of EXPAREL and ZILRETTA.

Our current product portfolio and product candidate pipeline, along with anticipated milestones over the next 12 to 18 months, are summarized in the table below:
EXPAREL (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension)

EXPAREL was approved by the FDA in October 2011 and was commercially launched in the U.S. in April 2012. EXPAREL is a long-acting, non-opioid proven to manage postsurgical pain. EXPAREL consists of bupivacaine, an amide-type local anesthetic, encapsulated in our pMVL drug delivery technology, which delivers bupivacaine over time for extended analgesia. It is the only product indicated for local analgesia via infiltration in patients aged six years and older and regional analgesia via interscalene brachial plexus nerve block, sciatic nerve block in the popliteal fossa, and adductor canal block in adults (safety and efficacy have not been established in other nerve blocks). In November 2020, the European Commission, or EC, granted marketing authorization for EXPAREL as a brachial plexus block or femoral nerve block for treatment of post-operative pain in adults, and as a field block for treatment of somatic post-operative pain from small- to medium-sized surgical wounds in adults and children aged six years and older.
Pacira BioSciences, Inc. | 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K | 6

We believe EXPAREL addresses a significant medical need for a safe and effective long-acting non-opioid postsurgical analgesic and plays a significant role in opioid minimization strategies. EXPAREL is designed for recovery with minimal opioid use by: (i) delivering targeted local analgesia at the surgical site; (ii) reliably releasing bupivacaine over time for prolonged analgesia; (iii) eliminating the need for catheters and pumps that may hinder recovery and (iv) providing long-lasting pain control while reducing the need for opioids.

Net product sales of EXPAREL were $575.1 million, $549.0 million and $538.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, net product sales of EXPAREL accounted for 79%, 78% and 80% of our total revenues, respectively.

headings: Risks Related to the Development and Commercialization of our Products and Product Candidates
Our success depends primarily on our ability to successfully commercialize EXPAREL and ZILRETTA.
We face significant competition from other pharmaceutical, medical device and biotechnology companies. Our operating results will suffer if we fail to compete effectively.

If we are unable to establish and maintain effective marketing and sales capabilities or enter into agreements with third parties to market and sell our products, we may be unable to generate additional product revenues.
We may need to increase the size of our organization and effectively manage our sales force, and we may experience difficulties in managing growth.
We may not be able to manage our business effectively if we are unable to attract and retain key personnel.
We may need to expand our manufacturing operations or outsource such operations to third parties.
Our co-production and other agreements with Thermo Fisher may involve unanticipated expenses and delays.
Supply chain disruptions could interrupt product manufacturing and global logistics and increase product costs.
Our operations are dependent on the global supply chain and impacts of supply chain constraints and inflationary pressure could adversely impact our operating results.
We make substantial investments in research and development and unsuccessful investments could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Our business involves the use of hazardous materials and we must comply with environmental laws and regulations, which can be expensive and restrict how we do business.
Any collaboration arrangements that we may enter into in the future may not be successful, which could adversely affect our ability to develop and commercialize our product candidates.

We have invested a significant portion of our efforts and financial resources in the development and commercialization of our lead product, EXPAREL, which was first approved by the FDA in October 2011 and commercially launched in April 2012. EXPAREL was approved by the EC (which included the U.K.) in November 2020. During 2025, sales of EXPAREL accounted for 79% of our total revenue, and we expect EXPAREL sales will remain of primary importance for the foreseeable future. We added ZILRETTA to our product portfolio upon completing the Flexion Acquisition in November 2021 and it accounted for 16% of our total revenue in 2025. Our success primarily depends on our ability to continue to effectively commercialize EXPAREL and ZILRETTA. Our ability to effectively generate revenues from EXPAREL and ZILRETTA will depend on our ability to, among other things:
•create further market demand for EXPAREL and ZILRETTA through our marketing and sales activities and other arrangements established for their promotion;
•train, deploy and support a qualified sales force;
•secure formulary approvals for EXPAREL at a substantial number of targeted hospitals and ASCs;
•manufacture EXPAREL and ZILRETTA in sufficient quantities in compliance with requirements of regulatory agencies and at acceptable quality and pricing levels in order to meet commercial demand;

The foregoing reference to our corporate website is not intended to, nor shall it be deemed to, incorporate information on our corporate website into this Annual Report by reference, and the inclusion of our corporate website address in this Annual Report is an inactive textual reference only and is not intended to be an active link to our corporate website.
Pacira BioSciences, Inc. | 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K | 78 Overview

Our stated corporate mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients. We are also developing innovative interventions to address debilitating conditions involving the sympathetic nervous system, such as cardiac electrical storm, chronic pain and spasticity. Our long-acting, local analgesic EXPAREL® (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension) utilizes our unique pMVL drug delivery technology that encapsulates drugs without altering their molecular structure and releases them over a desired period of time. In the U.S., EXPAREL is a long-acting, non-opioid option proven to manage postsurgical pain. EXPAREL is the only product indicated for local analgesia via infiltration in patients aged six years and older and regional analgesia via interscalene brachial plexus nerve block, sciatic nerve block in the popliteal fossa and adductor canal block in adults. We drop-ship EXPAREL directly to end-users based on orders placed to wholesalers or directly to us, and there is no product held by wholesalers. With the acquisition of Flexion Therapeutics, Inc. in November 2021 (the "Flexion Acquisition"), we acquired ZILRETTA® (triamcinolone acetonide extended-release injectable suspension), the first and only extended-release, intra-articular injectable therapy that can provide major relief for OA knee pain for three months and has the potential to become an alternative to hyaluronic acid, or HA, and platelet rich plasma, or PRP, injections or other early intervention treatments. With the acquisition of MyoScience, Inc. in April 2019 (the "MyoScience Acquisition"), we acquired iovera®°, a handheld cryoanalgesia device used to deliver a precise, controlled application of cold temperature to targeted nerves, which we sell directly to end users. EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and the iovera° system are highly complementary products as long-acting, non-opioid therapies that alleviate pain. We are also advancing the development of PCRX-201 (enekinragene inzadenovec), a novel, locally administered gene therapy for the treatment of OA of the knee. PCRX-201 is the lead program from our HCAd vector platform, which enables local administration of genetic medicines and has the potential to unlock gene therapy for large prevalent diseases affecting millions of people. In February 2025, we acquired GQ Bio Therapeutics GmbH, a privately-held biopharmaceutical company (the "GQ Bio Acquisition"). PCRX-201 is the lead program from this platform.

We expect to continue to pursue the expanded use of EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and iovera° in additional procedures; progress our product candidate pipeline, including the development of PCRX-201; advance regulatory activities for EXPAREL, ZILRETTA, iovera° and our other product candidates; invest in sales and marketing resources for EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and iovera°; expand and enhance our manufacturing capacity for EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and iovera°; invest in products, businesses and technologies; and support legal matters.

•In January 2026, we announced the appointment of Samit Hirawat, M.D., to our board of directors. Dr. Hirawat brings with him more than 25 years of clinical development and industry expertise. This appointment increases the size of our board of directors to 10 members. Most recently, Dr. Hirawat served as Chief Medical Officer, Executive Vice President, and Head of Global Drug Development at Bristol Myers Squibb, where he oversaw its worldwide clinical development portfolio and advanced multiple transformative therapies across therapeutic areas. Dr. Hirawat was concurrently appointed to the Science and Technology Committee of our board of directors.

•In January 2026, we announced a partnership agreement with LG Chem designed to expand access to opioid-sparing postsurgical pain control for patients in select Asian-Pacific markets. Through this partnership, LG Chem has the exclusive rights to commercialize EXPAREL for postsurgical pain management in the region. Under the terms of the agreement, we received a $2.0 million upfront payment and will also receive a transfer price and tiered royalties on future commercial sales by LG Chem in its licensed territories. In addition, we will supply EXPAREL product and LG Chem will be responsible for securing regulatory approvals in the licensed territories. LG Chem plans to file for marketing authorizations in South Korea and Thailand in 2026.

•As part of our ongoing commitment to maximize shareholder value, in the fourth quarter of 2025, we repurchased 2.0 million shares of our common stock through open market transactions for $50.0 million (exclusive of broker fees and excise tax incurred) under our share repurchase program. For more information, see Note 13, Stockholders' Equity, to our consolidated financial statements included herein.

Direct and indirect effects of global economic conditions have in the past, and may continue to, negatively impact our business, financial condition and results of operations. Such impacts may include the effect of prolonged periods of inflation or the imposition of tariffs, which could, among other things, result in higher costs for raw materials, equipment and other goods and services; cause patients to defer or cancel medical procedures, thereby adversely impacting our revenues; and negatively impact our suppliers which could result in longer lead-times or the inability to procure a sufficient supply of materials.
Pacira BioSciences, Inc. | 2025 Annual Report on Form 10-K | 79

While there has been no material impact on our business related to tariffs to date, the current macroeconomic environment remains dynamic and subject to rapid and possibly material changes. For instance, the U.S. government may in the future pause, reimpose or increase tariffs and foreign governments have, and in the future may, impose retaliatory trade protection measures. Our business may be impacted by ongoing risks associated with global macroeconomic conditions, including international relations and trade disputes. For example, and most notably for us, the active pharmaceutical ingredient for both EXPAREL and ZILRETTA are sourced from outside the U.S. In July 2025, the U.S. and the E.U. agreed to a trade deal that sets a 15% tariff on most imports from the E.U.—including branded pharmaceuticals—and effectively exempts the E.U. from higher tariffs that may be imposed on pharmaceutical imports from other countries pursuant to a pending investigation of such imports under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962. In December 2025, the U.S. and Switzerland reached a similar agreement, setting a 15% tariff on Swiss origin goods—including branded pharmaceuticals—and likewise exempting Switzerland from potential higher tariffs under the same Section 232 investigation. Pharmaceuticals imported from countries outside the E.U. and Switzerland may face higher tariffs, including tariffs that may be imposed pursuant to the pending Section 232 investigation. However, on February 20, 2026, the Supreme Court of the U.S. ruled against the country-specific tariffs, including the E.U. and Swiss specific tariffs mentioned above, imposed by U.S. President Donald Trump under his asserted executive authority. The Supreme Court held that the President did not have the authority under IEEPA to impose such tariffs, rendering them unlawful and no longer in effect. The Supreme Court ruling does not directly address whether, and if so how, the U.S. Government would go about returning any tariffs collected under these IEEPA tariffs.

Following the Supreme Court's ruling, President Trump implemented a blanket 10% ad valorem tariff on imports into the U.S. under Section 122, effective February 24, 2026. These tariffs are authorized to remain in effect for a period of up to 150 days. However, in an exemption list released by the White House on February 22, 2026, pharmaceuticals and pharmaceutical ingredients were excluded from the 10% ad valorem duties. Based on the ruling and subsequent executive actions, we do not expect any country-specific tariff impact on our pharmaceutical products at this time. Accordingly, while the trade and tariff landscape remains uncertain, we currently do not expect tariffs to have a material adverse impact on our business, financial condition, or results of operations. We will continue to monitor developments and assess any potential impact of the Supreme Court decision and related trade measures on our business and supply chain.

Such tariffs imposed by the U.S. and/or other countries that are currently in effect, or may take effect in the future, could increase our manufacturing and operating expenses in future periods, including the cost to deliver our products to commercial markets, the cost to source raw materials for the manufacturing of our products and the cost of materials used in our R&D activities. The imposition of future tariffs impacting our industry, the magnitude of response by other countries to such tariffs and the length of time such tariffs are in effect may also increase uncertainty and adversely impact our business.

There has been significant volatility in U.S. tariff and customs policy recently, with frequent changes in rates, sudden elimination or reinstatement of exemptions, shifts in implementation dates and reversals of prior actions. This volatility makes it more difficult to forecast costs, plan our global supply chain and provide reliable financial guidance. Policy changes often require rapid operational adjustments that can increase costs and reduce efficiency. We expect such volatility and uncertainty related to tariffs and customs to continue, potentially posing ongoing challenges to our operations, financial planning and investor communications.

paragraphs: Pacira BioSciences, Inc., 一間 Delaware 公司，為我們位於 California 的營運子公司 Pacira Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 的控股公司。在 2007 年 3 月，我們從 SkyePharma Holdings, Inc.（現為 Vectura Group Limited，為 Molex Asia Holdings, Ltd. 的子公司）或 Skyepharma 收購了 Pacira Pharmaceuticals, Inc.（稱為 "Skyepharma 收購"）。在 2019 年 4 月，我們收購了 MyoScience, Inc.，一間 privately held 的醫療科技公司（稱為 "MyoScience 收購"），在 2021 年 11 月，我們收購了 Flexion Therapeutics, Inc. 或 Flexion，一間 publicly traded 的生物製藥公司（稱為 "Flexion 收購"），並在 2025 年 2 月收購了 GQ Bio Therapeutics GmbH 或 GQ Bio，一間 privately-held 的生物製藥公司（稱為 "GQ Bio 收購"）。除非上下文另有要求，否則本年度報告中提及 "Pacira"、"we"、"the Company"、"the Registrant"、"us" 和 "our" 均指 Pacira BioSciences, Inc.，一間 Delaware 公司及其子公司。

我們於 2006 年 12 月在 Delaware 登記成立，公司名稱為 Blue Acquisition Corp.，並於 2007 年 6 月更名為 Pacira, Inc.。在 2010 年 10 月，我們更名為 Pacira Pharmaceuticals, Inc.，並在 2019 年 4 月更名為 Pacira BioSciences, Inc.。我們的總部及主要營運辦公室位於 California 的 Brisbane。
Pacira®、EXPAREL®、ZILRETTA®、iovera®°、Pacira 的標誌及其他出現在本年度報告中的 Pacira 商標或服務標誌均為 Pacira 所有，並在本年度報告各部分首次使用時包含 ® 識別符。
本年度報告包含其他公司的其他商標、服務標誌及專有技術名稱，這些名稱可能或可能不附有 ® 或 ™ 識別符。這些符號的缺席並不表示相關所有權人不會根據適用法律全力主張其權利。我們使用其他公司的商標或專有技術名稱，不應被視為對該公司有任何認可、贊助或其他關係。

我們的使命是提供創新、非嗎啡止痛療法，以改變病患的生活。我們有三種已商業化的非嗎啡治療方案：EXPAREL®（bupivacaine 脂質體注射懸浮液）、ZILRETTA®（triamcinolone acetonide 延長釋放注射懸浮液）及 iovera®°。EXPAREL—我們的旗艦產品—是一種長效、局部麻醉劑，目前批准用於術後疼痛管理。ZILRETTA 是一種延長釋放、關節內（IA，即在關節內）皮質類固醇注射，用於管理骨關節炎（OA）膝關節疼痛。iovera° 是我們新穎的手持式裝置，用於透過精確控制的冷溫度劑量，提供即時、長效、無藥物止痛，作用於目標神經。我們也在推進創新產品線，其中包括 PCRX-201（enekinragene inzadenovec），一種新型、局部給藥的基因治療，目前處於治療膝關節骨關節炎（OA）的 Phase 2 臨牀開發階段。PCRX-201 是我們專有高容量腺病毒（HCAd）載體平台的領先計畫，該平台可實現遺傳藥物的局部給藥，並有潛力為影響數百萬人的大規模常見疾病啟動基因治療。

在 2025 年 1 月，我們啟動了我們新的 5x30 戰略增長計畫（"5x30"），以加速我們轉型成為肌骨骼疼痛及相關領域的創新生物製藥與治療領導者。5x30 計畫聚焦於五個關鍵目標，我們預計在 2030 年前達成：(i) 每年服務超過三百萬病患；(ii) 產品收入以雙位數複合年成長率成長；(iii) 毛利率比 2024 年提高五個百分點；(iv) 推進創新產品線，至少有五個計畫處於臨牀開發階段；(v) 建立五個合作夥伴關係，包括產品線與商業協議。
自 5x30 計畫啟動以來，我們已朝向長期目標取得了顯著進展。在 2025 年，我們已服務 2.5 百萬病患；銷售趨勢顯示我們正朝向雙位數營收成長目標前進；我們預計透過提升製造效率，實現毛利率提高五個百分點的目標；產品線已取得進展，有新的預臨牀計畫；我們已增加兩項戰略合作夥伴關係，分別為 EXPAREL 和 ZILRETTA。

我們目前的產品組合與產品候選品項管道，以及預期在未來 12 至 18 個月的里程碑，於下表中進行總結：
EXPAREL (bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension)

EXPAREL 於 2011 年 10 月獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准，並於 2012 年 4 月在美國正式上市。EXPAREL 是一種長效、非阿片類藥物，已證實可管理術後疼痛。EXPAREL 由布比卡因（bupivacaine）組成，為一種醯胺類局部麻醉藥，封裝在我們的 pMVL 藥物遞送技術中，可持續釋放布比卡因，以達到延長的止痛效果。它是唯一被核准用於年齡六歲以上患者經皮 infiltration 進行局部止痛，以及經 interscalene 肌膚神經阻斷、坐骨神經阻斷於膕窩處，以及成人 adductor canal 阻斷（安全性和有效性尚未在其他神經阻斷中建立）的產品。2020 年 11 月，歐盟委員會（EC）核准 EXPAREL 用於成人術後疼痛的臂神經叢阻斷或股神經阻斷，以及用於成人及年齡六歲以上兒童的小至中型手術傷口的體表術後疼痛的 field block。
Pacira BioSciences, Inc. | 2025 年度年報（Form 10-K）| 第 6 頁
我們認為 EXPAREL 針對一種安全且有效的長效非阿片類術後止痛藥物有顯著的醫療需求，並在阿片類藥物減量策略中扮演重要角色。EXPAREL 設計用於術後恢復，並透過以下方式減少阿片類藥物的使用：(i) 在手術部位提供針對性的局部止痛；(ii) 可靠地持續釋放布比卡因以達到延長的止痛效果；(iii) 消除可能影響恢復的導管與泵浦需求；(iv) 提供長效的疼痛控制，同時減少阿片類藥物的使用。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日，EXPAREL 的淨產品銷售額分別為 575.1 百萬美元、549.0 百萬美元及 538.1 百萬美元。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日、2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日，EXPAREL 的淨產品銷售額分別佔本公司總營業收入的 79%、78% 及 80%。

本公司明確之企業使命為提供創新、非嗎啡止痛療法，以改變病患之生活。我們亦在開發創新介入方案，以解決涉及交感神經系統之嚴重疾病，例如心臟電氣風暴、慢性疼痛與痙攣。我們之長效、局部止痛藥物 EXPAREL®（布比卡因脂質注射懸浮液）使用我們獨特之 pMVL 藥物遞送技術，該技術可包覆藥物而不改變其分子結構，並在預期時間內釋放。於美國，EXPAREL 是一種長效、非嗎啡選項，已證實可管理術後疼痛。EXPAREL 是唯一被核准用於局部止痛之藥物，適用於年齡六歲以上之患者，以及區域止痛之藥物，適用於頸部神經叢神經阻斷、坐骨神經阻斷（位於膕窩）及大腿內側神經阻斷（成人）。我們根據經由經銷商或直接至我們之訂單，將 EXPAREL 直接運送到終端用戶，且經銷商無持有產品。透過於 2021 年 11 月收購 Flexion Therapeutics, Inc.（「Flexion 收購」），我們取得 ZILRETTA®（三甲基氫化可的松延效注射懸浮液），這是第一且唯一之延效、關節內注射療法，可提供三月之 OA 膝關節疼痛重大緩解，並有潛力成為透明質酸（HA）或血小板豐富血漿（PRP）注射或其他早期介入治療之替代方案。透過於 2019 年 4 月收購 MyoScience, Inc.（「MyoScience 收購」），我們取得 iovera®°，一種手持式冷卻止痛裝置，用以提供精確、受控之冷溫度至目標神經，我們直接銷售至終端用戶。EXPAREL、ZILRETTA 與 iovera° 系統為長效、非嗎啡療法，可緩解疼痛，具有高度補充性。我們亦在推進 PCRX-201（enekinragene inzadenovec）之開發，PCRX-201 是一種新型、局部給藥之基因療法，用以治療 OA 膝關節。PCRX-201 是來自我們 HCAd 矢量平台之領先計畫，該平台可實現遺傳藥物之局部給藥，並有潛力解鎖基因療法，以治療影響數百萬人之大規模常見疾病。於 2025 年 2 月，我們收購 GQ Bio Therapeutics GmbH，一傢俬人持有的生物製藥公司（「GQ Bio 收購」）。PCRX-201 是來自此平台之領先計畫。

我們預期將持續追求 EXPAREL、ZILRETTA 與 iovera° 之擴展使用於更多手術程序；推進產品候選人管線，包括 PCRX-201 之開發；推進 EXPAREL、ZILRETTA、iovera° 與其他產品候選人之監管活動；投資於 EXPAREL、ZILRETTA 與 iovera° 之銷售與市場推廣資源；擴展並提升 EXPAREL、ZILRETTA 與 iovera° 之製造能力；投資於產品、業務與技術；並支援法律事項。

•於 2026 年 1 月，我們宣佈任命 Samit Hirawat, M.D. 為本公司董事會成員。Dr. Hirawat 帶來超過 25 年之臨牀開發與產業經驗。此任命使本公司董事會成員數增加至 10 人。最近，Dr. Hirawat 曾擔任 Bristol Myers Squibb 之首席醫療官、執行副總裁及全球藥物開發部門主管，負責其全球臨牀開發組合，並推進多項變革性療法於各治療領域。Dr. Hirawat 同時被任命為本公司董事會之科學與科技委員會成員。

•於 2026 年 1 月，我們宣佈與 LG Chem 籤訂合作協議，旨在擴展特定亞太市場患者之嗎啡替代術後疼痛控制。透過此合作，LG Chem 享有於該地區商業化 EXPAREL 用於術後疼痛管理之獨家權利。根據協議條款，我們收到 2.0 百萬美元之預付金，並將於未來 LG Chem 在其授權地區之商業銷售中收到轉讓價格與階梯式版稅。此外，我們將供應 EXPAREL 產品，而 LG Chem 將負責在授權地區取得監管許可。LG Chem 計畫於 2026 年向韓國與泰國提交市場許可申請。
•作為本公司持續追求最大化股東價值之承諾之一部分，於 2025 年第四季，我們透過公開市場交易，以 50.0 百萬美元（不含經紀費用與印花稅）購回 2.0 百萬股本公司普通股，根據本公司股票購回計畫。如需更多資訊，請參閱本合併財務報表之附註 13，股東權益。
全球經濟狀況的直接與間接影響，過去曾對本公司業務、財務狀況及營業成果造成負面影響，未來也可能持續造成負面影響。此等影響可能包括長時間通貨膨脹或課徵關稅等情況，這可能會導致原材料、設備及其他商品與服務的成本提高；導致病患延後或取消醫療程序，進而對本公司營收造成不利影響；並對本公司供應商造成負面影響，可能導致採購材料的交貨時間延長或無法取得足夠的材料供應。

截至目前為止，與關稅相關的影響對本公司業務尚無重大影響，但目前總體經濟環境仍處於動態變化中，且可能迅速且具重大影響。例如，美國政府未來可能暫停、重新課徵或提高關稅，而外國政府已於過去並可能於未來課徵報復性貿易保護措施。本公司業務可能受到全球總體經濟狀況相關持續風險的影響，包括國際關係與貿易爭議。例如，對本公司而言，EXPAREL 與 ZILRETTA 的活性藥物成分皆來自美國境外。2025 年 7 月，美國與歐盟達成貿易協議，針對來自歐盟的大多數進口商品課徵 15% 關稅—包括品牌藥物—並實際上免除歐盟在根據 1962 年貿易擴張法案第 232 節對其他國家藥物進口可能課徵的更高關稅。2025 年 12 月，美國與瑞士達成類似協議，針對瑞士原產地商品課徵 15% 關稅—包括品牌藥物—並同樣免除瑞士在相同第 232 節調查下可能面臨的更高關稅。來自歐盟與瑞士以外國家進口的藥物可能面臨更高的關稅，包括根據待處理的第 232 節調查可能課徵的關稅。然而，2026 年 2 月 20 日，美國最高法院裁定美國總統唐納·川普根據其主張的行政權力所課徵的國家特定關稅—包括上述針對歐盟與瑞士的特定關稅—無效，因最高法院認為總統根據 IEEPA 並無此項權力，因此這些關稅違法且已不再生效。最高法院的裁決並未直接說明美國政府如何處理根據 IEEPA 關稅所徵收的任何關稅。

最高法院裁決後，唐納·川普總統於 2026 年 2 月 24 日根據第 122 節，對進口至美國的商品課徵 10% 的從價關稅。這些關稅可維持生效至多 150 天。然而，2026 年 2 月 22 日，白宮發布的豁免清單中，藥物與藥物成分被排除於 10% 從價關稅之外。根據裁決及後續的行政措施，本公司目前不預期任何國家特定關稅對本公司藥物產品造成影響。因此，雖然貿易與關稅環境仍不確定，本公司目前不預期關稅對本公司業務、財務狀況或營業成果造成重大負面影響。本公司將持續監測發展，評估最高法院裁決及相關貿易措施對本公司業務與供應鏈的潛在影響。
美國及其他國家目前生效或未來可能生效的關稅，可能增加本公司未來期間的製造與營運費用，包括將產品交付至商業市場的成本、取得用以製造產品的原材料成本，以及用於研發活動的材料成本。未來影響本公司產業的關稅、其他國家對此等關稅的反應幅度及此等關稅生效的時間長度，也可能增加不確定性並對本公司業務造成不利影響。
近期美國關稅與海關政策出現顯著波動，包括頻繁的稅率變動、突然取消或恢復豁免、實施日期的變更及先前措施的反轉。這種波動使預測成本、規劃全球供應鏈及提供可靠財務指引變得更加困難。政策變更往往需要迅速的作業調整，可能增加成本並降低效率。本公司預期這種與關稅及海關相關的波動與不確定性將持續，可能對本公司作業、財務規劃及投資者溝通造成持續的挑戰。

headings: 與我們產品及產品候選品之開發與商業化相關之風險
我們之成功主要取決於我們能否成功商業化 EXPAREL 與 ZILRETTA。
我們面臨來自其他製藥、醫療器材及生物科技公司之重大競爭。若我們無法有效競爭，我們之營運結果將受影響。
若我們無法建立並維持有效之行銷與銷售能力，或與第三方簽訂協議以行銷與銷售我們之產品，我們可能無法產生額外之產品收入。
我們可能需要擴大組織規模並有效管理銷售團隊，我們可能面臨管理成長之困難。
若我們無法吸引並留住關鍵人才，我們可能無法有效管理我們之業務。
我們可能需要擴大製造業務或委外給第三方執行製造業務。
我們與 Thermo Fisher 之共同生產及其他協議可能涉及預期之外之費用與延誤。
供應鏈中斷可能影響產品製造與全球物流，並提高產品成本。
我們的營運依賴全球供應鏈，供應鏈限制與通貨膨脹壓力可能對我們的營運成果產生不利影響。
我們在研究與開發方面進行大量投資，若投資未成功，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
我們的業務涉及使用有害材料，我們必須遵守環境法規與相關規定，這些法規可能費用高昂且限制我們的營運方式。
我們未來可能進行的合作安排未必成功，這可能影響我們開發與商業化產品候選物的能力。
paragraphs: 除本年度報告中其他資訊外，下列所列因素可能顯著且負面影響本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果或前景。本公司普通股的交易價格可能因這些風險而下跌。本節包含前瞻性陳述。您應參閱本年度報告第1頁開始的關於前瞻性陳述之限制與條件說明。這些風險因素並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉或認為不重要，亦可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或未來成果產生重大不利影響。

本公司已投入相當多的資源與努力於我們主要產品 EXPAREL 的開發與商業化，該產品於2011年10月首次獲美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）核准，並於2012年4月正式上市銷售。EXPAREL 於2020年11月獲歐盟委員會（EC，包含英國）核准。2025年，EXPAREL 的銷售佔本公司總營業收入的79%，我們預期 EXPAREL 的銷售將在可預見的未來持續為主要收入來源。本公司於2021年11月完成 Flexion 收購後，將 ZILRETTA 加入產品組合，2025年 ZILRETTA 的銷售佔本公司總營業收入的16%。本公司成功主要取決於我們持續有效地商業化 EXPAREL 與 ZILRETTA 的能力。我們有效從 EXPAREL 與 ZILRETTA 產生收入的能力，將取決於我們能否，例如：
•透過我們的行銷與銷售活動及其他促進其推廣的安排，進一步創造 EXPAREL 與 ZILRETTA 的市場需求；
•培訓、部署並支援具備資格的銷售團隊；
•在大量目標醫院與 ASCs 獲得 EXPAREL 的處方清單核准；
•在符合監管機構要求、並在可接受的品質與價格水準下，製造足夠數量的 EXPAREL 與 ZILRETTA，以應對商業需求；
